record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly lower Adam learning rate from 8e-4 to 5e-4 and dropout from 0.15 to 0.10. Smaller updates may improve convergence precision, while reduced dropout preserves more signal in the predominantly short histories. Retain width 64, six causal blocks, history length 64, batch size 128, existing features, tied embeddings, readout, scoring and loss. Keep seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch; preserve metadata-based predictor reconstruction and one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly lower Adam learning rate to 5e-4 and dropout to 0.10. Smaller updates may improve convergence precision while reduced dropout preserves signal in short histories. Keep all other settings, features, architecture, scoring and loss unchanged. Existing metadata and predictor reconstruction remain compatible; inference disables dropout.
